**Finding: deviation (medium) — Section 11.1 Term**

What the document does:
- Initial term of five years, then **automatic one-year renewals** — renewal length complies (no multi-year auto-renewals).
- Either party may opt out on **30 days' written notice** — this already meets the preferred ≤30-day window, so I left it untouched.

Gaps against the playbook:
1. **No vendor renewal reminder.** Nothing requires Commerce One to flag an upcoming renewal, so the 30-day window can lapse silently.
2. **No renewal price cap.** Exhibit B (p0154) prices maintenance/support and MarketSite.net access only for "Year 1" and "Year 2-5, and beyond," with no uplift limit — renewal fees are effectively uncapped against Corio, the paying licensee.

Redline (validated, ok:true) appends two sentences to 11.1: a 60-day written renewal reminder from Commerce One, and a renewal fee increase capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with a 5% fallback offered in the comment.
